mechanism: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase and may increase ampicillin/amoxicillin rash risk; piperacillin tazobactam can elevate allopurinol levels by reducing renal clearance, increasing hyperuricemia risk and allopurinol toxicity.
action: Monitor for skin reactions and allopurinol toxicity; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring; consider dose adjustment of allopurinol if renal impairment develops.
